title: Graphing a 3D Wireframe Sphere from Scratch in Desmos
description:
Graphing a 3D Wireframe Sphere from Scratch in Desmos

In this Desmos 3D Masterclass, we explore 3D Wireframe & Mesh Engines using pure multivariable calculus and linear algebra inside the Desmos Graphing Calculator.

📐 Mathematical Architecture:
- Core Formula: X = \rho \sin\phi \cos\theta, \quad Y = \rho \sin\phi \sin\theta, \quad Z = \rho \cos\phi
- Concepts: Spherical Coordinates, Latitude-Longitude Parametrization, Orthographic vs Perspective
- Pedagogical Lesson: Spherical coordinates map the sphere using azimuth angle theta and polar angle phi. Wireframe meshes are generated by holding one angle constant while sweeping the other, producing latitude parallels and longitude meridians.
